parsed.rationale: All three records — `PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, and `OverlayBlendMode` — are `type-alias-union` declarations in the same `Wallpaper` package, sharing 16 fields with no differing slots (Jaccard/differing_slots both null), meaning their union members are structurally identical. Because they are all in the same package and none carry any restraint markers (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`, `is_codegen` are all false), consolidating them into a single canonical `BlendMode` type within `Wallpaper` eliminates the redundancy without any cross-package coupling concerns. The three separate names (`PlaybackBlendMode`, `MaterialBlendMode`, `OverlayBlendMode`) can then become `typealias` declarations pointing to the single `BlendMode` type if call-site source compatibility must be preserved, or be removed outright if callers can be migrated.
